result.summary: DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE — root cause reclassified from SCRAM auth failure to pg.zig stderr-on-error issue. Empirical evidence: (1) db_test uses trust auth (auth_type=0), not SCRAM; (2) reproducing iss107 today shows C23514 constraint violation as the actual error, NOT AuthenticationFailed at pg.zig:451. The OLD log (test-iss107-main.log) showing AuthenticationFailed was from a different transient state. The real issue: pg.zig prints POSTGRES ERROR to stderr on every query error, zig test runner treats any stderr as binary-level failure, so negative tests (which DELIBERATELY trigger server errors) abort the whole binary. Recommended fix: silence pg.zig stderr logging (Option A, ~30 lines in vendor/pg/pg.zig). See docs/issue-reports/WF03-GH542-20260807-step-05-issue-fixer-DIAGNOSIS.yaml for full evidence.

issues.description: GH-542 title and body claim SCRAM auth failure, but actual root cause is pg.zig stderr logging. Issue should be re-titled and body updated before fix workflow proceeds.
